china_race_dynamics.text:
This week, the leaders of the world’s two leading AI superpowers will meet.

AI is advancing fast—and the world needs clear lines of communication and meaningful guardrails to manage its risks. American leadership and diplomacy can help lead the way.

I joined 28 of my Democratic colleagues to call for a sustained and substantive dialogue with China to address AI-related safety risks.

deepseek.reason: The speaker calls for sustained US-China dialogue on AI safety without endorsing competition as a policy priority.
deepseek.confidence_reason: The statement clearly endorses cooperation; it does not reject or prioritize China competition.
